component.name: Opal
component.summary: A calm web browser with spaces, vertical tabs and Opal AI

description.p: Opal is a desktop web browser built on Chromium (through Electron) with a quiet, focused design.

ul.li: Spaces with their own tabs and bookmarks, vertical tabs and split view
Reader mode, picture in picture, find, zoom, print and save as PDF
Chrome Web Store extensions (partial API support)
Opal AI: ask about a page, summarize, translate and agent mode, using Ollama on your computer or your own Claude or OpenAI API key

screenshot.caption: Spaces, vertical tabs and the Opal AI panel
